tei:div.tei:p: oṃ swā sti/ rdo rje 'chang dbang dpal ldan dus 'khor dang*/ /zla bzang 'jam dpal grags pa pad dkar sogs/ /chos rgyal rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku rnams dang*/ /dus 'khor zhabs dang zla ba mgon po dang*/ /rigs ldan rnam 'phrul chos rje yab sras sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /bdag cag 'dir tshogs skal ldan gdul bya la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ /'dir zhing khams mchog tu gyur pa mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams/ gling khyad par can bdun pa las kyi sa/ dum bu bla na med pa 'dzam gling lho'i phyogs/ rgyal khams ngo mtshar can pu rgyal bod kyi yul/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi zhing khams khung ba/ rgyal sras byang sems kun gyi mdzad pa'i spyod yul/ gsang sngags 'dzin pa kun gyi gnas mchog dam pa/ gangs can ljongs 'di'i lte ba sa'i thig le/ ri bo stong phrag du ma'i dbus na mngon par 'phags pa/ sa 'dzin dbang po nags rgyal dpal gyi ri/ ru lag g.yas ru'i so mtshams/ phyi ltar na sangs rgyas kun kyi zab mo'i chos sgra sgrog pa'i gnas bya rgod phung po'i ri/ nang ltar na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi pho brang dam pa ri bo po ṭa la/ gsang ba ltar na rdo rje theg pa'i nges gsang 'byung zhing dar ba'i gnas byang phyogs sham bha la/ de kho na nyid ltar na dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor/ don dam ye shes sangs rgyas seng ge'i khrir bzhugs e waṃ zung 'jug gi ngo bo/ sgrub gnas bye ba phrag brgya'i dbus na/ lhun po ltar mngon par mtho zhing*/ grags pa nyi zla ltar gsal ba/ ri khrod chen po jo nang zhes yongs su grags pa 'di'i gnas kyi che ba'i dbang du byas na/ sa gzhi la rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i yon tan dang*/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i che ba dang*/ sgrub brgyud chu bo'i gzhung ltar rgyun ma chad cing dar ba'i gzi brdzid dpal dang ldan pa'o/

/dang po sa la rang bzhin gyi sa grub pa'i yon tan ni/ gangs can man+dha ra dang lhun po sogs/ /lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin bgrang yas kyis/ /nye bar bstan pa'i ri'i rgyal po rnams/ /phyogs 'dir gcig tu 'dus pa lta bur yod/ /phyogs bzhi'i ri rnams rtse mo shin tu mtho/ /rtsa ba brtan cing dbyibs legs lhun stug chags/ /ngos rnams sman ljongs nyams dga' yangs pa dang*/ /zla ba chu shel in+d+ra nī la sogs/ /nor bu'i phung po brtsegs 'dra'i brag ri mdzes/ /ri bo'i sul rnams nags tshal sna tshogs dang*/ /ljon shing du mas rnam par brgyan pa yod/ /zla ba drug tu me tog sna tshogs bkra/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kun sel byed pa/ /sman mchog rnam pa sna tshogs du ma yi/ /dri zhim ngad kyis phyogs kun khyab pa dang*/ /rnam pa sna tshogs 'bras bu chags pa ni/ /'chi med dbang po mchod sbyin brgya pa'am/ /mi 'am ci yi rgyal po ljon pa ni/ /'khor bcas rol zhing rtsa ba'i skyed tshal 'dra/ /ri bo'i mgul nas char sprin gsar pa 'khrigs/ /bdud rtsi'i char zim rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab/ / mthong bas yid 'phrog thos na nyams dga' zhing*/ /bsdad pa tsam gyis ting 'dzin ngang gis skye/ /klu yi rgyal po rgya mtsho'i rtse sa 'dra/ /'bab chu sna tshogs lhung lhung sgra 'byin cing*/ /ri dwags du ma bag phab bde bar rgyu/ /'dab chags sna tshogs snyan pa'i ca co sgrog /rta bdun rgyal po lho yi khyim gnas pa'i/ /zla ba drug tu ri dang ri bo'i sul/ /ri drung ri yi shod kyi ngogs rnams su/ /rmad byung ya mtshan kha dog sna tshogs 'char/ /ston ni gser dang byi ru'i 'phreng ba spel/ dgun dus ri dbang rgyas pa'i rtse mo rnams/ /bco lnga'i zla ba nya rgyas lta bur 'gyur/ /yan lag brgyad ldan 'bab chu du ma can/ /ri mtho sa gtsang rig pa shin du dwangs/ /lu hi ta zhes chu klung tshangs pa'i bu/ /'bab chu'i rgyal po byang gi phyogs su rgyu/

/rgyal ba'i zhal mthong grub pa'i dam la gnas/ /'dren pa'i bstan pa gces par skyong ba yi/ /lha mo mthu ldan nags sman rgyal mo ni/ /lha sman 'bum gyi tshogs dang lhan cig tu/ /dga' bas rol zhing lha srin sde brgyad la/ /dbang bsgyur rdzu 'phrul chen pos skyong ba'i gnas/ /ri rgyal 'di yi ri 'dabs khor yug na/ /grub pa'i gnas dang lha khang gtsug lag khang*/ /chos grwa brgya phrag du mas bskor te gnas/ /de las khyad par gnas mchog dam pa 'di/ sa gzhi e yig chos kyi 'byung gnas 'dra/ /mkha' la rang byung 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dbyibs/ /ri rnams pad+ma 'dab ma rgyas pa 'dra/ /nub byang dpal gyi ri bo sngo 'bor skyong*/ /mtho zhing brjid chags ri rgyud du mas bskor/ /phyi rol rgyal khams gzhan nas bltas pa'i tshe/ /sa las rdo rje rtse lnga lta bur 'phags/ / gnas 'di'i nang gi gang nas bltas gyur kyang*/ /'khor los bsgyur rgyal gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra/ /byang shar phyogs na rta mchog rin chen zung*/ /de'i drung na dmag dpon rin po che/ /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba 'dra ba yod/ /byang gi phyogs na nye bar brten pa ni/ /brag ri'i 'phreng ba 'khor lo rin chen 'dra/ /de 'og seng rdzong zhes grags brag ri ni/ /blon po rin chen gtso la gus pas 'dud/ /nor bu rin chen 'dra ba'i brag ri ni/ /nub byang phyogs gnas ri de'i ngos la ni/ /'dab chags dbang po du ma dga' ba'i rol/ /grub pa'i gnas mchog du mas brgyan pa yod/ /lho yi phyogs na yid 'ong ri yi dbyibs/ /btsun mo rin chen mngon du phyogs pa 'dra/ /nub phyogs ri ni glang chen nyal ba bzhin/ /mdun ri lhun chags sman ljongs rgyas pa ni/ /'bru yi phung po lta bur dbyibs legs shing*/ /gnod sbyin dbang po gter gyi bdag po'i gtso/ /'phags pa dzam bha la yi dbyibs su yod/ /phu ni gzengs mtho lcags ri lta bus bskor/

/mda' ni ma shor phyag rgya lta bur bsnol/ /shar ri'i ngos la bkra shis dpal be dang*/ /gnas lugs mtshon pa a yig gsal bar dod/ /g.yon phyogs dngul gyi phye mas g.yogs 'dra ba'i/ /ri bo dar yol lta bus mdzes par byas/ /don dam e la waṃ yig bzhugs pa ltar/ /gnas kyi lte bar mthong grol chen mo ni/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /mthong thos dran reg 'brel tshad don ldan ni/ /rmang ni sa gzhi lta bu rgyu che zhing*/ /rtse mo skye med gnas la reg pa snyam/ /bkod legs rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang 'dra/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa/ /rab 'byams rgya mtsho zhes bya'i zhing khams dang*/ /'od dpag med kyi gnas mchog bde ba can/ /mi 'khrugs zhing khams mngon dga' la sogs dang*/ /'dod pa'i khams kyi mchog rab dga' ldan dang*/ /gzugs khams rtse mo dbang phyug chen po'i zhing*/ /mkha' khyab 'og min stug po bkod pa sogs/ kun 'dus bdag nyid mchod rten dpal yon can/ /sku gzugs gzhal du med pas gang ba bzhugs/ /mtha' skor kho ra khor yug phyogs kun tu/ /gtsug lag khang dang sgrub gnas bgrang yas yod/ /dbus ni he ru ka dpal dus 'khor sogs/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug rnams kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ /phyi rol phyogs mtshams dur khrod chen po brgyad/ /rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor zab mo dang*/ /rgya che'i dkyil 'khor ngo mtshar rmad du byung*/ /gnas mchog dam pa 'dir ni su bsdad kyang*/ /chags sdang la sogs nyon mongs ngang gis sangs*/ /dge ba'i chos rnams gong nas gong du 'phel/ /gnyid rmugs sel zhing rigs pa dwangs pa'i gnas/ /zhen chags sel zhing nges 'byung 'phel ba'i gnas/ /gnod sems 'bri zhing snying rje rgyas pa'i gnas/ /rnam g.yengs spangs shing zhi gnas brtan pa'i gnas/

/log rtog mi 'byung lhag mthong ngang gis skye/ /gnas mchog 'di dang mtshungs pa gzhan yod min/ /phyogs 'dzin can gyis bsngags pa brjod pa dang*/ /the rang 'gong pos grags pa bsgrags pa dang*/ /dbang sdud nor sgrub la sogs rten 'brel kyis/ /'du 'tshogs can dang grags pa che ba 'gar/ /rmongs pa'i 'gro rnams chu ltar rgyug pa la/ zhing mchog dam par 'khrul dang 'di mi mtshungs/ /gzhan du lo dang zla bar bsgoms pa bas/ /gnas mchog 'dir ni zhag dang za ma tsam/ /bsgoms pa'i phan yon lhag par che ba yin/ /gzhan du dge sbyor 'bad de bsgoms pa bas/ /sdig pa'i las spangs chos dang bla ma la/ /mos gus byas nas gnas 'dir nyal ba yang*/ /bla med byang chub mchog la nye ba yin/ /nya pa gdol pa ri dwags rngon pa dang*/ /mtshams med byed pa la sogs sdig can yang*/ /gnas 'di bskor zhing sgrub chu 'thung pa dang*/ khrus byas phyag dang skor ba mchod pa phul/ /de yis sdig pa dag nas lha yul skye/ /skye bo gzhan dag smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /gnas mchog 'di ni mthong ba don ldan yin/ /de ltar na mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i gnas mchog 'di ni/ rgyal ba shākya seng ge la sogs pa sngar byon pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi bzhugs gnas su stsal ba lags/ gnyis pa skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i che ba ni/ gnas 'di dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs shing*/ sgos su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing mchog tu gdod nas grub pa yin pa las/ bstan pa 'di la mi'i skye ba nye bar gzung ba'i tshul bstan pa'i dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs tshul ni/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba sprul pa'i sku de nyid kyis/ brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi gnas rnams su byon zhing*/ khyad par nags rgyal gyi ri la lan mang du phebs pa dang*/

yang dgos gnas 'dir zhag bdun bzhugs par grags shing*/ phug chen gong ma dang phug pa gong 'og rnams su chags phab/ de rjes su rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la bzhugs pa/ snubs chen nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ ngam 'bre klu'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ sna mnam pa tshul khrims 'byung gnas la sogs pas kyang sgrub gnas su mdzad cing*/ bod dbus gtsang gi phyogs 'dir gsang sngags brgyud kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad pa la thog mar bka' drin che ba sgra sgyur gyi rgyal po 'brog mi lo tsā pa'i slob ma/ mo grub pa thob pa bzhi'i gtso mo/ bzang sgom dkon mchog zhes bya bas/ thog mar nags rgyal gyi shar mgul du cung zad bzhugs/ de nas gnas 'dir byon te yun ring du bzhugs shing*/ mthar 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa yin/ bzhugs gnas da lta yang yod pa 'di lags/ de rjes su lo brgyad cu skor song ba na/ ma cig sangs rgyas ri mas gnas 'dir chags phab/ yun ring du bzhugs shing bka' gdams dang rdzogs chen gyi sgrub grwa bskyangs par gda'/ bzhugs gnas dang chos grwa da lta yang yod pa 'di lags/ de nyid kyi sgrub grwa ma stongs pa'i rgyun la/ mi ring bar dpal ldan grub thob 'dar phyar rin chen bzang po phebs te/ thog mar tshogs pa ma bskyangs/ sgrub pa kho na mdzad cing bzhugs/ phug chen 'og mar bdag med lha mo bco lnga dang 'khor lo bde mchog sogs zhal gzigs/ phug chen gong mar slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dngos su zhal mjal te/ pad+ma dbang chen gyi chos skor mtha' yas pa'i bdag por bskos/ nus mthu thogs pa med cing byin rlabs dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i grub thob rtsod med du gyur pa yin par gda'/ de skabs gsang 'dus rim lnga gtso bor gyur pa'i gsang rnying gnyis 'dus kyi sgrub grwa mdzad/ grub thob nyid kyis mi'i bla ma gzhan la ma gsan yang*/ sems 'grel skor gsum la gzigs kyin don thugs nyams su bzhes pas/

sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i nyams rtogs mthar phyin pa mnga' bar 'dug de rjes mi ring bar sngar gyi sgrub grwa'i rgyun ma stongs pa la/ rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku mkhas btsun bzang po'i mthar thug /rtags mngon gyur gyi grub thob chen po zhang kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ mtshan gyi khyad par gzhan kun spangs chen po kun tu bzang po zhes bya bas phebs pa yin te/ de yang chos rjes kun spangs chen po de nyid/ se mkhar chung na bzhugs pa'i dus/ grub thob se ston kun rig gi sku'i skye ba yin pa yang thugs kyis dran/ gzhi bdag rnying pa rnams kyis kyang ngo shes/ rgyud kyi snying po mdzad pa'i thog mar dge ba'i gzugs ltas kyang byung*/ brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi gtso mo/ nags sman rgyal mos jo nang du spyan 'dren pa'i zhu ba yang yang phul/ de la da lta dus la cung zad ma bab pas da res mi 'tshal/ lo gsum nas 'ong zhes zhal gyis bzhes/ de bar du lha sa yer ba sogs dbus phyogs su 'gro don cher mdzad/ sngar gyi phyi nang gi rten 'brel 'dzom pa las/ lo gsum gyi mtshams de nas spyi brag nags gsum gyi mkhan slob dge 'dun thams cad mgrin gcig pas nan tan du gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/ gnas mchog dam par 'dir chags phab/ de tsa na gnas 'di'i rgyun bzhugs sgrub pa po sum cu tsam yod par grags/ thog ma lo gcig seng rdzong du bzhugs/ de nas 'khyogs po'i btsan gyis gdan drangs/ 'khyog por gzims khang mkha' spyod bde ldan du/ thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba'i mtshan ma brnyes nas rgyud kyi snying po rtsa 'grel tshang bar mdzad/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i snyan rgyud yi ger bkod pa'i thog ma 'khrid yig chen po yang mdzad/ de rjes sku tshe'i smad la sgrub gnas skyid phug bde ldan du gdan phab par gda'/ de skabs phyogs bcu nas 'dus pa'i chos mdzad sgrub pa pho mo tshogs pa nyung dus kyang drug brgya re rtag tu 'dus shing*/

de nas brtsams te da lta'i bar du rgyud thams cad kyi nges gsang zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa gtso bor gyur pa'i sgrub grwa rgyun ma chad cing*/ dar zhing rgyas par gyur pa lags te/ chos rje kun spangs chen pos gnas 'dir lo nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzhugs/ de nas byang sems rgyal ba ye shes kyis lo brgyad/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtshos lo bdun rnams gdan sa mdzad pa rnams la'ang sgrub brgyud je 'phel du gyur/ de rjes rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku chen po/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i glegs bam gcig gyur/ ngur smrig 'dzin pa kun gyi khyu mchog rgya chen byang chub sems kyi mnga' bdag mtha' bral nges don bstan pa'i bdag po/ rtags dang yon tan mtha' dag ma sbas mngon du gyur pa'i/ grub thob kyi 'khor los bsgyur pa chen po/ chos rje kun mkhyen dol po pa mtshan brjod par dka' ba shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyis/ lo bco lnga'am bcu gsum gyi bar du gdan sar bzhugs dus/ skabs de nyid dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems can mthong thos dran reg thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sa bon gdab pa'i phyir du/ mthong grol gyi sku 'bul chen mo bzhengs/ bshad sgrub mtha' dag gi sgo nas mdo rgyud kyi bstan pa sgo thams cad nas rgyas par mdzad/ de rjes thugs sras dam pa sgra sgyur lo tsā ba chen po blo gros dpal bzang po rgyal tshab du mnga' gsol nas lo ngo bco lnga gdan sar bzhugs pa dang*/ de rjes mkhan chen phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis lo drug gdan sa mdzad/ de rjes lo gsum tsam nas mkhas grub dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gdan sar mnga' gsol mdzad de/ de rnams kyi ring la yang kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po nyid gnas mchog dam pa 'di nyid du bshad sgrub kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i ri khrod sna tshogs su sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa spel ba dang*/

chos sde dang grwa sa tha dad pa rnams su chos kyi 'khor lo mtha' yas pa bskor bar mdzad/ de ltar kun mkhyen chen po 'di'i sku thog la tshogs pa nyung dus su yang stong phrag gnyis re 'tshogs/ mang ba la tshod bzung du med/ nam zhag rgyun du mdag sbyar mtshams bcad pa rang yang stong phrag re mi 'chad pa 'byung*/ gnas 'dir 'tshogs phyin dge sbyor gyi sne mi zin pa ye mi yong*/ sems 'brel skor gsum dang*/ byams chos sde lnga dang*/ bslab bsdus spyod 'jug sogs gzhung lugs kyi 'chad nyan dang*/ dbang sgrub mchod lag len man ngag sgo thams cad nas spel bas/ bshad nyan gyi zur chos pa yang lnga bcu tsam re rtag tu bzhugs/ mdor na nges don gyi bstan pa nam langs pa dang nyi ma shar ba bzhin du gyur pas/ sngon chos rje kun spangs chen pos gnas 'dir pha las bu lhag bu las tsha lhagatsha las yang tsha lhag pa 'byung zhes dang*/ da lta bzang ldan bar mar chos 'chad/ ma 'ongs pa na mchod rten bzhengs zhes lung bstan pa thog tu bab pa der gda'/ de nas slar yang mkhan chen phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis lo bco lnga'i bar gdan sa mdzad pa dang*/ de rjes rim can du kun mkhyen byang chub seng ge mkhas mchog nya dbon chen po kun dga' dpal/ mkhan chen rgyal ba jo bzang*/ rgyal sras chos dpal mgon po/ 'dren mchog shes rab bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po/ mkhas btsun chos dpal bzang po/ 'jims chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'jims chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba nam mkha' chos skyong ste/ de yan chad mdo sngags mtha' dag dpal jo nang pa kho na'i bka' srol 'dres med kho na yin zhing*/ gdan rabs de thams cad rigs ldan gyi sprul pa'i sku yin par grags so/ /de rjes kyang gdan rabs su byon pa thams cad mkhas btsun bzang po sha stag byon pa lags te/ 'dren mchog nam mkha'i mtshan can gyi rjes su/ byang sems dpal ldan rin chen/ mtshungs med chos skyong rgyal mtshan/

sgo rum kun dga' legs pa/ bstan 'dzin nam mkha' bzang po/ mkhas pa rin chen bkra shis/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchogabastan 'dzin kun dga' dpal bzang rnams byon/ de rjes da lta'i bla ma dam pa'o/ gzhan yang gnas 'dir ri khrod so so'i sgrub gnas skyong ba'i sgrub pa mo dang sgrub chen grub brnyes mang po dang*/ zur chos kyi slob dpon dang*/ rdor 'dzin mdzad pa sogs mkhas grub du ma zhig byon pa lags na'ang*/ mtha' yas par brjod kyi ga la lang*/ skabs 'di dag tu spro na/ chos rje yab sras la sogs pa bla ma rnams kyi che brjod/ rnam thar rgyas bsdus rnams nas ci rigs par blangs la 'tsham par bshad do/ /gsum pa/ sgrub brgyud chu bo'i gzhung ltar rgyun ma chad cing dar ba'i gzi brjid dpal dang ldan pa'i yon tan ni/ kha ba can 'di na sngon sgrub gnas bsam gyi mi khyab pa byon zhing/ da ltar yang sgrub grwa mang du yod mod kyi/ sgrub grwa 'di dang por tshugs pa dang dus mnyam pa'i sgrub grwa bshad grwa rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ 'di dag las ches 'phyi ba dus phyis btab pa rnams kyang*/ 'ga' zhig ni rtsa ba nas stongs/ 'ga' zhig ni grong yul dang ser khyim du song*/ kha cig sngon gyi shul du da lta sgrub grwa yod pa'ang 'dug mod kyi/ bar skabs su stongs pa'i shul la gsar 'debs byas pa dang*/ kha cig ser khyim gyi sa nas gtsang ma'i grwa gsar du phye ba dang*/ bar skabs su ser khyim du song ba rnams phud nas/ de'i shul du grwa tshang ngam sgrub grwa gsar 'dzugs byas pa kho na yin gyi/ lo sum brgya bzhi brgya tsam du gang stongs dang ser khyim la sogs pas bar ma chod par/ bla brgyud chos brgyud gcig cing*/ nyams len gyi rgyun gcig pa'i sgrub brgyud bar ma chad par dar ba ni/ bod gangs ri'i khrod na sgrub gnas dam pa 'di kho na las gzhan med/ gnas 'dir ni ma cig ri ma nas gzung ste/

deng sang gi bar du sgrub grwa rgyun ma chad pa'i dbang du byas nas/ lo lnga brgya tsam song zhing*/ chos rje kun spangs chen po phebs pa nas chos brgyud gcig cing*/ nyams len gyi rgyun gcig pa'i sgrub brgyud 'di kho na la'ang*/ da lta yan chad du lo bzhi brgya lhag tsam song ngo*/ /de ltar na gnas gcig tu tshugs pa'i sgrub brgyud la dpal jo mo nang dang*/ gnas gcig tu tshugs pa'i bshad grwa la gsang ne'u thog bstan pa'i rgyun gang stongs med par gnas yun ring ba yin ces/ shes ldan blo gzu bor gnas pa rnams la grags shing phyogs gcig nas don la'ang gnas pa yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang dpal ldan gsang phu na/ phyis byung lo nyis brgya tshun la/ sa dge so so'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa ma gtogs/ rngog lo yab sras dang*/ phya tshang la sogs pa gsang phu ba rang lugs kyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa med la/ gnas mchog 'dir ni lta grub nyams len gyi rgyun gcig kho nas byin rlabs kyi rgyun la bsre bslad med pa dang*/ gzhan yang tshig bshad tsam gyi rgyun ma yin par sgrub pa nyams len snying por byed pa'i srol ka rgyun ma chad cing*/ dus kyi tha ma 'di lta bur yang lag len du thebs ba'i gra yin pas na/ cig shos las kyang ches khyad par du 'phags shing*/ ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yin no/ /sgrub gnas kyi rgyal po dpal ldan jo mo nang 'dir mthong grol chen mo gnas kyi lte bar byas pa'i mtha' skor gyi sgrub gnas byin rlabs can rnams cung zad smos na/ rgyab ri'i g.yon phyogs nyi bstan 'di la/ chos rje yab sras bzhis bzhugs shing rdo rje phag mo'i gnas skyid phug bde ldan 'od gsal brag de'i g.yas phyogs na rin po che shes rab 'bum pa dang*/ mkhas mchog nya dbon chen po kun dga' dpal dang*/ rgyas sras dngul chu chos rdzong ba'i thugs sras rgya ma pa yon tan 'od sogs skyes bu dam pa du mas bzhugs pa'i gnas shug pa gnam 'phyang bde chen brag

de'i stod na mkhas grub o rgyan pa dkon mchog grags pa'i bzhugs gnas sgrub khang 'di lags/ sbud bkra dbu rgyan pa las cung zad bgres pa gcig yin/ o rgyan du lo lnga bzhugs/ grub rtags mngon rgyur ba mnga'/ chaus rje kun spangs chen po'i mched grogs gong ma lags par gda'/ skyid phug gi g.yon phyogs kyi brag na/ ma cig ri ma'i chos grwa dang bzhugs gnas/ de'i g.yon phyogs su phug pa chen po gong 'og gnyis yod pa'i/ gong ma ni slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bzhugs gnas dngos de yin par grags shing*/ phyis grub thob 'dar phyar rin chen bzang pos yun ring du bzhugs/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang mngon sum du mjal/ rta mgrin yang gsang gi chos skor mtha' dag gi bka' babs brnyes sa der gda'/ phug pa 'og ma 'dir grub thob 'dar phyar nyid kyis bdag med lha mo bco lnga dang*/ 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes sogs kyi zhal gzigs sa der gda'/ phug pa 'di gnyis kar du grub thob des yun ring du bzhugs pas/ deng sang 'dar phyar phug pa gong 'og tu grags/ skyid phug gi 'og na mkhas btsun yon tan brgya mtsho dang*/ kun mkhyed chos kyi rgyal po gnyis car gyi slob ma dge slong bkra shis bzang po zhes bya ba/ mngon shes thogs med du mnga' ba/ sku gshegs dus byang chub kyi sems spyi bor 'khyil bas dbu gtsug tu gtsug tor gyi rnam pa shin tu rgyas te rmog gi khyon tsam byung ba/ de lta bu'i bzhugs gnas phug pa dang*/ de'i 'og phyogs na kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po nyid 'dzin pa'i nyams rtogs mthar phyin pa'i tshul bstan sa rdo rje gdan zhes bya ba'i phug pa dang*/ pad+ma gdan zhes bya ba'i phug pa gnyis yod/ de'i 'og g.yon ngos brag pad+ma kha 'bus lta bu'i rtse la/ chos rje kun spangs chen po dang*/ byang sems :chen pos kyang

£¨¡¶dzaṃ¡· rin po che £©cung zad bzhugs shing*/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtshos yun ring bzhugs pa'i gzims khang bde ba can zhes bya ba 'dir/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos kyang yun ring du bzhugs/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba zhal gzigs/ bde ba can gyi smon lam mdzad pas nub bde ba can gyi zhing khams kyi bkod pa dngos su gzigs shing*/ mthong grol gyi sku 'bum chen mo la lus kyi las dang*/ rgyu nor longs spyod kyi 'brel pa thogs tshad rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham par skye ba gcig nas brtsams te/ skye ba bdun tshul chad la zhing khams rnam dag bde ba can du skye la/ theg chen chos kyi dga' ston la spyod par 'gyur ba'i 'khrul med kyi ltas mngon sum du gzigs/ gnas kyi ming bde ba can mtshan don dang mthun pa lags/ de dag gi g.yon ngos phyogs blon po rin po che 'tshogs pa lta bu'i brag 'di la/ sgrub gnas dam pa gsang sngags 'jigs med seng ge rdzong zhes bya ba/ chos rje kun spangs kun tu bzang pos rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor los bstan pa spel ba'i bar du dge ba'i rtags dang mtshan ma byung ba'i gnas de lags/ de'i 'og tu rta ra gdong zhes grags pa 'di na/ sbud bkra o rgyan pa'i slob ma zla seng gis kyang cung zad bzhugs/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i slob ma/ grub chen rta ra ba zhes bya ba/ lce chung gi bdud rtsi kho nas tshim ste/ sku tshe smad lo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar du mi zas bza' btung gzhan rnams gsol mi dgos pa lta ci smos/ mtha' na chu snyim pa gang tsam yang ma gsol ba/ gdan dang na bza' la sogs pa'i spros pa ye mi dgos pa des bzhugs shing*/ de'i stod brag ri ngos gzar po'i phug pa chung ngu phal gyis bgrod dka' ba 'dir/

kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po nyid kyi slob ma grub chen dbus pas bzhugs/ grub thob de yang zla ba phyed phyed tsam mi zas ye gsol mi dgos/ thugs nyams 'ur res kyi sku 'bum chen mo'i phyir ngos nas brgyud de rtse la thal byung du gshegs/ char khebs kyi ze pro la phyag ya re tsam zhabs ya re tsam bzhag pa'i ngang nas 'phags cing bskor ba lan mang du mdzad/ slar bum ldir chen mo'i steng du 'bebs kyi tshul du rdo rje'i skyil krung phab pas nyams sad 'gro ba zhig yin par 'dug rgyab ri'i g.yas kyi ngos la chos rje yab sras thams cad dang bla ma mkha' spyod pa la sogs pa mkhas grub dpag tu med pa'i bzhugs gnas/ mkha' spyod zung 'jug rdo rje'i rdzong zhes bya ba/ da lta 'khyog po'i brag ces zer ba yang dben gnas mchog ngo mtshar can 'di bzhugs/ 'dir chos rje kun mkhyen chen pos srog rtsol gyi nyams rtogs rgyud nas bshad pa bzhin mthar phyin pa'i tshul bstan/ de'i g.yon du brag phug pad+ma rā ga dang*/ g.yas su phag mo'i dur khrod do/ /gnas mchog dam pa 'dir lho nas shar gyi bar mdun gyi ri la/ phu na rdza bye 'ur grags pa 'di/ chos rje kun spangs chen po dang*/ byang sems chen po'i slob ma mo grub pa thob pa zhang btsun ma yon tan mtshos bzhugs shing*/ de ni 'dzin pa'i nyams rtogs mthar phyin/ rtsig pa la thogs med du gshegs/ ma zos bkres med zos kyang 'ju/ /thur sel mi 'dzag bde ba rgyas/ /zhes sogs kyi yon tan mngon gyur du mnga'/ phu shar nub kyi ri rtse la phar 'phur tshur 'phur mdzad par grags shing*/ las stod pa dbang rgyal gyis kyang bstod bskur cher mdzad pa de yin/ de rjes kun mkhyen chen pos kyang cung zad bzhugs shing*/ zhal slob sgrub pa mo ye shes rgyan zhes bya ba mngon shes rgya che la brtan pa mnga'/ phyi nang bar gsum 'phral yun thams cad thogs med du mkhyen pa zhig dang*/

sgrub pa mo zhang btsun ma chos mtsho zhes bya ba/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems mnga' ba nus mthu chen pos/ dge slong bkra shis bzang po gshegs la khad kyi dus su/ nga'i tshe'i lhag ma lo bdun khyed la 'bul/ khyed kyi tshab tu nga 'gro gsung nas de ma thag snyung ba med par gshegs/ dge slong pa'ang de 'phral snyung ba gdangs/ lo bdun bzhugs te/ de lta bu'i grub brnyes ngo mtshan can de rnams kyis bzhugs pa'i gnas lags/ 'di'i g.yon na gzhong stod kyi dur khrod dang*/ shar ngos kyi lung pa na/ 'brog mi'i slob ma mo grub pa thob pa prad mo dkon ne'i sgrub gnas rnams bzhugs shing*/ gzhan yang phyis thebs pa la/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i slob ma sgrub chen ma 'od gsal skyid kyi sgrub gnas dang*/ sgrub chen ma dpal mo mtsho'i sgrub gnas/ deng sang rdza shar nub tu grags pa gnyis/ gzhan yang gling bzhir grags pa/ bde chen byang chub gling*/ 'od zer gling*/ khra'u gling*/ bsam gtan gling ste/ gling bzhi dang*/ dbu rtse gtsug lag khang lha khang du ma dang bcas bzhugs pa 'di lags/ de dag ni gnas spyi'i bshad pa mdo tsam lags te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyi zhing khams 'dir/ /brtson 'grus ldan pas rtse gcig 'bad gyur na/ /ma dag rnam smin lus 'di gnas gyur nas/ /rdo rje'i sku mchog tshe 'di nyid la 'grub/ / brtson pa 'bring po'ang bar dor sangs rgya zhing*/ /brtson 'grus tha ma yis kyang lam sna zin/ /gnas mchog 'di dang chos brgyud 'di nyid la/ /dam tshig ma nyams sdig chen ma bsags na/ /'bad rtsol med kyang snyoms las dbang gyur kyang*/ /gnas 'dir bsdad pa tsam gyis dge sbyor skye/ /sa bcu'i byang sems rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku/ /de dag rnams kyi byin rlabs ngang gis 'jug /dad pa chen pos phyag mchod skor ba dang*/ /gsol ba btab na yid ches 'phral 'phral 'byung*/ /lan gcig mjal ba'ang bar chad kun zhi zhing*/

/lan gsum bskor bas ngan 'gro'i skye sgo khegs/ /lan mang mjal na mtshams med byas pa yang*/ /rnam par dag nas bde chen gnas su 'gro/ /mthong thos dran reg thams cad don ldan pa'i/ /gnas mchog 'di dang mtshungs pa 'ga' yang med/ /zung 'jug ye shes chen po'i pho brang 'dir/ /dad pa bskyed cing 'brel ba 'jog pa rnams/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /rnam mkhyen go 'phang thob pa'i dge legs 'phel/ / <zhes dge slong kun dga' snying pos bris/> bkra shis/ dge legs 'phel/ sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyis byin brlabs pas/ /dngos grub thams cad 'bad med 'byung ba'i gnas/ /'dir ni mkha' mnyam sems can don phyir du/ /bdag kyang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par shog/shu bhaṃ/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/jo nang gi gnas bshad bzhugs/ - PAGE 140 -- PAGE 141 -- PAGE 136 -
